issue.title: Task-bead burn-down 2: false deploy refusals, a red dotfiles CI, and leaking e2e scratch
issue.description: The five open task beads that now cost agents the most time are fixed and closed: the chezmoi isolation test that fails every dotfiles push, the two deploy-guard arms that falsely refuse plugin syncs, the real-Obsidian e2e runners that fill athena's /tmp, and the most-reported bob-plugins perf flake. The lander triages what is left and proposes the next five-bead epic under the same rules, and the chain continues until no open task beads remain.

payload.entry: deploy-inclusion-proof done. evaluate_guard: clean-stamp arm tries find_inclusion_proof when ancestor_of is not Yes and incoming is clean (permits with proving_commit); dirty-stamp arm runs the proof regardless of incoming cleanliness (permits with proving_commit; refusal kept when no proving commit exists). Chose permit-over-reword for pb: proof is about vault bytes having landed, so overwriting cannot erase unlanded work even from a dirty checkout. Docs/help updated in same change (cli.rs long helps, docs/plugins.md guard bullets + recovery para, bob-plugins docs/develop/deployment.md, CLI reference via just docs-gen). Tests: 4 new unit tests in src/native/plugins/tests.rs + 1 new CLI test (clean unknown head via rewritten stamp); cargo test --lib -- native::plugins 65/65, --test cli plugins:: 36/36, docs_reference ok, just docs-check 449 passed, live dry-run from linked bob-plugins checkout exit 0 no refusals. just-check stays red only on pre-existing HEAD failures in untouched prose files (clippy + lib kinds + cli root_help), owned by epic bob-cli-qj.5.1; full lib otherwise 8278 passed. Closed bob-cli-or and bob-cli-pb with verification notes.
